about: Texts the npm guard and the Python client (python/memory_pulse.py Ledger.check) must judge alike, over one ledger. Cases 1 to 12 are the twelve of an independent review (2026-11-21, G-4): the two disagreed on 8, 9, 10 and 12 because the Python client matched a withdrawn term as a substring and never received the token rule of 2026-10-12. The rest cover a term that spans lines, a word that keeps its inflections, and an ambient word. `blocked` is the verdict both must give. Both test sides read this file.
